We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 5 reactions for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have guidance: steps enumerated forward: likely include TBS protection, HWE, DIBAL-H reduction, TMSOTf protection, Still-Gennari etc. But we need retrosynthetic steps (reverse). So we need to break target into precursors via 5 steps.

We need to produce JSON route with type mol root, children reaction nodes etc.

We need to find appropriate template IDs for each step. We have one template ID from search: reaction_id 29646 corresponds to deprotection of TBS? The retro_smarts_template: '[C:2]-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2]' This is forward? Actually retro_smarts_template shows product to reactant? It says [C:2]-[OH]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si]... So forward (retro) is deprotection? Wait: The template likely is for protecting alcohol with TBS (forming O-Si). The retro direction (retrosynthesis) would be breaking O-Si to give OH. So we can use this template to go from protected to deprotected. Our target has free OH groups (multiple). So maybe earlier step had TBS protected groups that were later deprotected. So we need to apply reverse of that template: i.e., in retrosynthesis we would go from target (with OH) to a protected precursor (with TBS). That uses the forward direction of the template (protect). The template ID is 29646.

We need other steps: HWE (Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons) to form double bond and carboxylic acid? The target has a carboxylic acid at end of chain (C(O)=O). That likely came from HWE of a phosphonate with aldehyde to give α,β-unsaturated acid (E). So retrosynthesis: break C=C bond adjacent to carbonyl to give aldehyde and phosphonate. Need template for HWE. Search.
